alexcrichton opened PR #14389 from alexcrichton:refactor-slightly to bytecodealliance:main:

  • Scope platform-specific things to a unix and not_unix module to avoid having #[cfg(unix)] in a lot of places
  • Remove pin-projection bits as they aren't necessary
  • Don't plumb inherited sockets as arguments through lots of locations and instead store it as state on ServeCommand itself.
